ordering: lower priority number first; edges are actual dependencies, optional nodes do not block undamped local work

nodes.title: Certified undamped packet window
nodes.implementation: Introduce immutable generated descriptor; interval moments, candidate/force/residual, all-mode reconstruction and scalar bounds; use actual S and max|xi|.
nodes.interface: local_window_verified(model,h,tol) -> centers, outward radii, source identity, work
nodes.acceptance: Independent exact one-mode solutions plus high precision adversarial multi-mode fixtures enclosed at every requested output; NaN/Inf/forged input refused; no missing arithmetic terms.
nodes.cost_contract: O(Np)+polynomial and enclosure cost; instrument all setup/output terms.

nodes.title: Weighted global trajectory
nodes.implementation: Implement T1 verified E+, true/candidate mean tube and continuous output residual; tie each returned center to its radius; transport inherited radii transactionally.
nodes.interface: advance_verified(state,window) -> committed state or typed rejection with retained work
nodes.acceptance: Independent full trajectory inclusion for mean/all modes, nonzero initial radii and rejected windows; fixed requested physical tolerance not relaxed.
nodes.cost_contract: O(N) tube/transport plus O(1) gain per window; compare rejection count at same certificate.

nodes.title: Native common-damping packet
nodes.implementation: Connect e^(-2κt) nonlinear forcing, interval damped moments, explicit rotating/lab frame and carrier enclosure; width gate and stable alternate scalar kernel.
nodes.acceptance: κ=0 confluent limit; exact damped linear and one-mode cubic cases; large κh finite inclusion or explicit refusal; full multiwindow test after A02.
nodes.cost_contract: Charge scalar kernel precision/setup and all requested outputs.

nodes.title: Leja full arithmetic authority
nodes.implementation: Close matrix product, recurrence, coefficient, summation additive underflow and norm enclosures; bind operator structure; then selectively restore certified status.
nodes.acceptance: Independent high precision cases across subnormal/normal/overflow and adversarial forged caches; component terms include coefficient-radius cross term; warmed zero allocations unchanged.
nodes.cost_contract: One-time suffix setup O(128m²), storage O(m²), coefficient tails O(m²); measure cold/warm separately.

nodes.title: Generic dense-output residual controller
nodes.implementation: Construct continuous reconstruction defect and verified full tube one-sided gain; use it to control all requested outputs; add failed-callback work charges and zero-span config validation.
nodes.acceptance: New PR101-point witness must satisfy unchanged normalized tolerance at all outputs; rigorous interval residual establishes between-point coverage; count added JVP/LU work.
nodes.cost_contract: Compare existing Off/Enforce/verified routes at fixed output and error; do not omit dense validation cost.

nodes.title: Strong rank-two direct baseline
nodes.implementation: Port exact Woodbury prototype to preallocated native factors, 2×2 Schur enclosure and residual witness; use carrier0 for current rotating-frame model.
nodes.acceptance: Same frozen Jacobian/stage RHS as dense route; verify full residual and nonsingular/singular Schur cases; n1,2,4,8 and larger native sizes.
nodes.cost_contract: O(N) setup, O(N) each RHS; all reconstruction and Schur certification counted.

nodes.title: Comparable benchmark and generated report
nodes.implementation: Same equation, atol vector, output grid, setup boundary and independent reference; allocator-based measured counts; retain failed arms; pin external Cargo.lock; generate Markdown from validated JSON.
nodes.interface: BenchmarkRow includes measured/error kinds, failure status and exact source/build/config
nodes.acceptance: All rows schema-valid; zero report/data discrepancies; no speed decision without same physical error/output and declared timing protocol.
nodes.cost_contract: Include cold/warm setup, reference excluded consistently, output and certification cost; independent timing uncertainty.

nodes.title: Polynomial route choice
nodes.implementation: Reuse Laguerre quotient/near-annihilator and PY02 conditions; compare complete cost and error to existing Krylov/Leja on the same admitted operator class.
nodes.acceptance: Verified spectrum/structure and total-error conditions; same outputs; all setup and basis conversion retained; candidate can abstain.
nodes.cost_contract: Operator products, memory, scalar setup and certificate costs; avoid equating degree reduction with elapsed speed.

nodes.title: Homotopy parallel target preservation
nodes.implementation: Use real nonlinear client, certified branch/endpoint residual and H5 perturbation witness for represented floating K; parallelize independent work with explicit span/work.
nodes.acceptance: Same target and output tolerance as sequential baseline; preserve all initial states; do not assume floating K nilpotent; count barriers/warmup/fallback.
nodes.cost_contract: Total work vs parallel span including iteration dependency; finite Picard rounds only under proved exact causality.

nodes.title: Adaptive Bernstein enclosure
nodes.implementation: Use T2 convex-hull bounds only when cheap coefficient bound fails; outward basis transform and dyadic de Casteljau with monotone min.
nodes.acceptance: Exact (1−τ)^d family plus complex/vector cases; full inclusion and refinement stopping; original tail-model preserved.
nodes.cost_contract: O(d²) transform/subdivision, streaming O(d); instrument false-rejection savings.

nodes.title: EX01 full Jacobian symmetric-part bound
nodes.implementation: Replace generic maxdiag shortcut by full μ2 upper on tube; GrayScott reaction2×2 eigenvalue formula plus contractive diffusion yields O(N) bound.
nodes.acceptance: Reject offdiagonal counterexample J=[[-1,100],[0,-1]] for maxdiag shortcut; bound all tube reaction blocks outward.
nodes.cost_contract: O(N) local block bounds instead of dense symmetric eigensolve.

nodes.title: Scoped production decision
nodes.implementation: Independent review of completed scope, actual nonlinear client and declared deployment/error/output domain; leave other routes separately held.
nodes.acceptance: Close only the dependencies of the selected scope; independent scopes may promote separately. Preserve original tolerance, actual source identity and failed attempts.
nodes.cost_contract: No additional unchanged historical campaign rerun; validate changed dependencies only.
